WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as avg_all_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
equip_avg AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
above_avg_equip AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity
  FROM equip_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > oa.avg_all_humidity
    AND oa.avg_all_humidity IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as mean_above_avg
  FROM above_avg_equip
)
SELECT 
  aae.equipref,
  aae.avg_humidity,
  aae.avg_humidity - oa.avg_all_humidity as exceeds_all_avg,
  aae.avg_humidity - aam.mean_above_avg as exceeds_group_mean
FROM above_avg_equip aae
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean aam
WHERE aae.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND oa.avg_all_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND aam.mean_above_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY exceeds_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
